# WG5 · Tài chính · Phiếu thu & thông báo

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · tab · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#receipts`
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role care: consult, session, photos.
- Patient 360 tabs removed for role accountant: consult, session, photos, crm.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":".finance-workspace .metric, .finance-workspace .hero"} → {"click":"[data-finance-tab=\"receipts\"]"}; it must show `#payment`.
